title: Hatsune Miku — Rooftop Chat〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew... That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for your help, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was my pleasure.
You also seemed a bit lonely since the girls aren't here today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What? I wasn't lonely.
And I'm sure they're all off enjoying their own moon viewing parties.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, so let's make sure to ask them all about what they all did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
Miku, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho. Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What are you doing here?
Shouldn't you be with your sister right now...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I am.
But I wanted to give you guys these...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are these dango...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku and I just had a moon viewing party, but we ended up with some extra dango.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. And based on your smile, is it fair to say that you had a lovely time?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is also why I came by to thank you all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. Remember the story I told you about me and Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After that, on my way home, I ended up watching her stream...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, how was it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, she kept talking about us when we were little, which was pretty startling at first.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
She must love you just that much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... I guess...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ironically, her talking about us helped me understand how she really felt about me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, this goes back to that story I told you and how I believed that I'd never really done anything for Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But during her stream, she talked about how she was encouraged by some of the things I did.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. See?
Didn't I say that she probably feels the same way?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, you had a moon viewing party with her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It was myself, Shizuku and the other idols from her group.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How was it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A little rowdy at times, but really fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I found out that one girl's a big Phenny fan too, so we talked a lot about that. Oh, and this older girl made some delicious dango dishes for us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And Shizuku was just Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wish I could've been there.
I'd love to meet your sister.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that won't be necessary...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you two weren't there to nudge me forward that time, I probably wouldn't have been able to realize what I did and spend time with my sister like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These dango are also my way of saying thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I appreciate what you did for me, Miku, Luka. You gave me the courage to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But still, I'm glad...
Especially since it sounds like you had a really lovely evening.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And thank you for the dango as well. We'll make sure to share some with MEIKO and Rin.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we invite them over and have ourselves a little moon viewing party?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to join us and have some dango together, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm pretty full already. Also, I have school tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But please invite me next time. For now, good night...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good night, Shiho. And thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm so glad her evening went so well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You were so worried about her too, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, you were too. Right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: True. But I'm also glad that she was able to spend such quality time with her sister.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Now then...
Shall we go find MEIKO and Rin?
